title: バイオ・化学大意(応用バイオ)
subtitle: Introduction to Bioscience and Chemistry (Applied Bioscience)
educationalGoal: Our college aims to nurture understanding and analytical ability of chemical and biological phenomena and to cultivate chemical and biotechnological engineers. In this course, you will understand the significance of learning chemistry, biology and their application fields, and the roles of engineers in related industrial fields. The objective of this course is to acquire the ideas necessary to achieve your future goals in your individual specialized field.
advice: 1.System of bioscience and chemistry Understand the curriculum flow chart for 4 years. 2.Application fields of bioscience Systematic study of bioscience can be applied to a wide range of industries. 3.Introduction to research fields and fostering scientific thinking abilities In this course, you will understand three areas of study: biotechnology, brain science, and genetic engineering. 4.State-of-the-art research introduced by professors at the Department 5.General exercise Writing assignments should be submitted to the Portfolio.
requiredKnowledge: No prerequisites. Be sure to prepare for and review the class every week.

activityGoals.body: Ability to learn independently based on understanding the roles of bioscience and chemistry.
Ability to learn independently based on understanding of the educational objectives of this Department.
Ability to explain the significance of studying at university.
Ability to explain the roles of bio-engineers in the related fields of bioscience.
Ability to consider the future development of bioscience fields logically and explain it properly.
Ability to describe your career plans and future dreams aimed at contributing to the community.
